## ExpiryDebugInfo.expiry property

The expiry that tough-cookie actually enforces: `null` for a session cookie, the epoch (see [ExpiryDebugInfo.expiryImmediate](./tough-cookie.expirydebuginfo.expiryimmediate.md)<!-- -->) for an already-expired cookie, otherwise the absolute expiry instant.

**Signature:**

```typescript
expiry: ExpiryDebugInstant | null;
```
